summary: An ingenious range of Basins, Toilets and Baths for small bathrooms, engineered with a focus on purposeful design.
title: New Decus Game Changer For Small Bathrooms
bodyHtml:
Compact Elegance, Reimagined

Decus is designed to bring refined Italian style to even the most compact bathrooms and powder rooms. Every piece in the collection is masterfully crafted to balance purposeful design and timeless aesthetics, so no matter the size, your bathroom can shine with sophistication.

Beautiful, Purposeful Design

With shorter projections that maximize both physical and visual space, Decus proves that smaller spaces don’t have to compromise on luxury or performance.

The innovative design enhances comfort during use, while creating an illusion of openness, making it the perfect solution for compact settings.

Soft Lines, Bold Statements

Our new Synthesis Eco range of toilets effortlessly complements the soft square aesthetic and chamfer base found throughout our Decus collection.

Handcrafted by Italy's own Olympia Ceramica, Synthesis Eco combines cutting-edge functionality with beautiful design for a seamless finish that elevates any bathroom, no matter the size.

Signature Soft Chamfer Aesthetic

The Decus Bath is the perfect statement piece to complete your bathroom transformation. Its sleek, sculptural form, made from our signature stone composite material, adds a luxurious touch while maintaining the space-saving ethos of the Decus collection.

With its natural matte finish and superior heat retention, the Decus Marmotech Bath invites moments of tranquility, turning any small bathroom into a haven of relaxation.

Explore the Range
